title: Paginate Products (Page 3, 5 per page)
description:
Return products for **page 3** of a catalog, where each page shows **5 products**, sorted by `id` ascending. (Skip the first 10, return the next 5.)

**Table: products**

| Column | Type |
|--------|------|
| id | INT |
| name | VARCHAR |
| category | VARCHAR |
| price | DECIMAL |
| stock_quantity | INT |

Output columns: `id`, `name`, `price`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INT, name VARCHAR, category VARCHAR, price DECIMAL, stock_quantity INT); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Laptop','Electronics',999.99,10),(2,'Phone','Electronics',699.99,25),(3,'Desk','Furniture',299.99,5),(4,'Chair','Furniture',149.99,8),(5,'Monitor','Electronics',349.99,15),(6,'Keyboard','Electronics',79.99,50),(7,'Mouse','Electronics',39.99,80),(8,'Webcam','Electronics',59.99,30),(9,'Headset','Electronics',89.99,20),(10,'USB Hub','Electronics',29.99,60),(11,'Notebook','Stationery',4.99,200),(12,'Pen Set','Stationery',9.99,150),(13,'Stapler','Stationery',14.99,75),(14,'Tape','Stationery',3.99,300),(15,'Scissors','Stationery',6.99,100);
solution_sql: SELECT id, name, price FROM products ORDER BY id LIMIT 5 OFFSET 10
hints: LIMIT n OFFSET m skips the first m rows and returns the next n.
For page p with page_size s: OFFSET = (p - 1) * s.
explanation: Page 3 with 5 items per page means skip 10 rows (`OFFSET 10`) and take the next 5 (`LIMIT 5`). This retrieves products with ids 11–15.
